input: Sample resume vs Data Analyst JD
expected: ATS 50-80; Power BI listed as missing keyword

section_feedback.feedback: Includes core technical tools like Python, SQL, and Excel, but missing key requirements like statistics, Power BI/Tableau, and A/B testing.
Movie recommender project includes a metric (precision@10 of 0.82), but needs clearer context on tools used (e.g., Pandas/SQL) and business application.
Degree and CGPA are clearly stated, but could benefit from listing relevant coursework such as Statistics or Database Management.

rewrite_suggestions.after: Developed a movie recommendation system using Python and Pandas, achieving a 0.82 precision@10 metric.
Designed and developed a responsive college event website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
